All done. Here's a summary of the work:

- **`mas-repository.js`** — Added `generateUniqueFragmentTitle(baseTitle, path)` async method that strips any existing `-N` suffix, searches existing fragment titles at the parent path, and returns the lowest available unique title. Updated `copyFragment` to compute `parentPath` and `uniqueTitle` from the helper and always save when the title needs to change.
- **`mas-fragment-editor.js`** — Added `this.titleClone = this.fragment.title` in `showClone()` so the dialog opens pre-populated with the source fragment's title.
- **`editor-panel.js`** — Same one-line fix to the parallel clone dialog in `EditorPanel.showClone()`.
- **`mas-repository.test.js`** — Added a `describe('generateUniqueFragmentTitle')` block with 5 tests covering: no duplicate, appends `-1`, increments to `-2`, strips existing suffix before incrementing, and graceful fallback on search failure.

**`git diff --stat`:** 4 files changed, 98 insertions(+), 4 deletions(−)
